name: Mothra
description: (Tag:informant)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:resource)(Tag:titanic-size)Mothra is a Hollow Earth flying Titan with extreme size-matched stats, incredible flight speed, weather and planetary sensing, and hyper-durable silk that can restrain titans. When killed she cheats death by returning to familiar space as an egg that hatches in about a week.
